summary: Red Mountain lookout in Lincoln County, Montana: 1933 pole tower, R-6 cab in the 1950s, destroyed 1959. No source describes the site today.

facts.design: 30-foot pole L-4 tower, with an R-6 cab added in the 1950s
facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1959 per firelookout.com. No source describes what remains at the site.

events.note: R-6 cab in the 1950s. The source gives only the decade, so 1950 is a placeholder year.
Destroyed 1959, per firelookout.com. The source gives no cause.

evidence.supports: tower dated 1933, listed as 30-foot pole L-4
Montana list marks the tower as gone
no source describes the site today

notes_for_editor: Dates, design and destruction year rest on one source (firelookout.com). The Forest Fire Lookout Association list agrees on Tower and Gone. The montanalookouts.weebly.com page for this site has only a header (Kootenai National Forest, 36N-29W-9), so it is not cited. Two searches found no staffing, fire or site-today information. Access is unknown, so no access fact is written.
